payload.rationale: Brief journey_stage is 'comparing': the couple is weighing Bali venues and areas, so the primary invitation sits straight after the like-for-like comparison and the list of details venues do not publish, where the reader most needs answers in writing. The secondary follows areas and travel, the magazine serves earlier-stage readers, and the closing CTA ends the post. Each subtext carries one brand-facts reassurance: inclusions in writing (primary), single point of contact (secondary), AUD quotes, time zone and fee in writing (closing). No figures, 'free', perks, Privileges or availability wording. All four tracked links already appear once each with correct UTMs, so no copy change is made. A printable Bali venue comparison checklist would be a better-matched magnet; none is known to exist, so it is a backlog suggestion only and not placed.
